description: FUGO - Share To Screens helps users manage screens, media, folders, content, dashboards, playlists, triggers, and Spaces from ChatGPT. The app can discover workspace data, upload media, create and publish playlists, share URLs or HTML directly to screens, stop active screen shares, and perform scoped Space administration in the authenticated user's FUGO tenant.
